title: Update Hunch decision count metadata after main merge
context: Repository merged main branch; Hunch (engineering memory system) grew from 292 to 294 decisions. Metadata in configuration files must stay synchronized.
decision: Updated decision counter from 292 → 294 in all 5 canonical locations: .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .windsurf/rules/hunch.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md.
consequences: Tooling and documentation reflect current Hunch state across all IDE/tool integrations
Synchronization burden: same number must be updated in 5 places whenever Hunch grows
alternatives_rejected: Leave metadata stale (creates discrepancy between actual/advertised state)
Automate the sync (commit suggests manual regeneration)
